name: bordercut
description: Language-neutral background-removal specification and TypeScript reference package.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @bordercut/core && npm run dev --workspace @bordercut/minimal-web-example
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bordercut/core && npm run build --workspace @bordercut/minimal-web-example
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @bordercut/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @bordercut/minimal-web-example
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:pack
